intro: Piwi Picker, the browser extension, sends the locators you pick to the {cursor} and follows the runs this {window} starts.
howToPair: To pair, click Pair under Editor in Piwi Picker's settings, then type here the code it shows.
notACode: Type the eight letters Piwi Picker shows, such as BCDF-GHJK.

request.title: Chrome on macOS asks to pair
request.prompt: Piwi Picker in Chrome on macOS asks to pair with this {editor}, to send it the locators you pick and follow its runs. If you just clicked Pair in Piwi Picker, type the code it shows.
